opennyai_summary.decision:
3.  The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
" It is therefore prayed that your Lordships shall be graciously pleased enough to admit the aforesaid writ petition ,issue a writ in the nature of mandamus or any form of writ/writs issuing Rule NISI calling upon the Opposite Parties particuliarly the Land Acquisition Officer, Puri as to why direction shall not be given to him to deal with the application filed by the petitioner on 24.04.2023 under Annexure-4 and to pass appropriate order on it to refer the matter to authority as per Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acuqisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for taking a decision, considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, And pass any other order/orders, direction/directions, writ/writs as this Hon'ble deem fit and proper;
And for this act of kindness the petitioner shall ever pray.
As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.3 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-4, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
